articles.title: Strategy CEO says company will resume Bitcoin accumulation this year

articles.title: ARP Digital secures Dubai VARA broker-dealer license
articles.summary: The license allows ARP Digital to offer regulated digital asset and stablecoin conversions into UAE dirhams as it expands its Gulf presence beyond Bahrain.

articles.title: Bluesky’s active user base is shrinking as its focus expands beyond the app
articles.summary: Over a year following its post-election surge, Bluesky’s mobile app is seeing a continued decline in active users, though its remaining community is still relatively engaged.

articles.title: Ebola: Over 2,000 dead in DR Congo as virus gathers pace
articles.summary: Authorities in the DRC say the Ebola virus is killing faster than any outbreak on record. Scientists have also said the outbreak may have started earlier than previously thought.
